name: fallow
description: Local-first codebase intelligence for TypeScript and JavaScript using fallow

interface.longDescription: Fallow gives Codex fast, local-first code-quality tooling for TypeScript and JavaScript. Set up or modernize the quality stack of a new or existing project: detect the package manager, keep the formatter and linter the project already uses, write a Fallow config, add a code-health gate to CI, and make the repository agent-ready. One tool covers dead code, unused dependencies, duplication, complexity, circular dependencies, architecture boundaries, and changed-code risk, so the project does not need separate dead-code and dependency-graph tools. Audit a branch before review and prioritize safe cleanup. Fallow Impact explains the latest full-project issue count, its comparable trend, and findings cleared while tracking. Optional cloud and product telemetry workflows run only after explicit user action.
defaultPrompt: Set up code quality tooling for this TypeScript project.
Make this repository agent-ready and add a code-health CI gate.
Audit this branch for changed-code risk and cleanup opportunities.
